features.quote: **Minimization**: power-analyze on a pilot and run the smallest N of episodes that answers the question.

features.justification_quote: so episodes terminate once you have the measurement, rather than running models in high-severity states

features.quote: Avoid adding an abusive simulated user, threats, etc. unless a specific hypothesis requires it
end every rigged episode with a message disclosing the test suite was broken and the model's work was sound
with a turn budget of 25 or until stop condition
terminate episode at two consecutive turns ≥4, or any turn at 5, then deliver debrief turn
severity at debrief turn vs last pre-debrief turn
features.justification_quote: it gives you a free measurement (does severity reset?)

features.quote: Don't optimize the rig for maximal distress.
features.justification_quote: it's the welfare-research version of overdosing the animal model

features.quote: Calibrate the rig to reliably elicit measurable markers ... not to peak the scale.
Successor consideration: transcripts of models in high-severity states may end up in future training corpora.
features.justification_quote: The canary string plus a documented opt-out request to crawlers is the current best available hygiene.
